dct_creator_sm: Mohun, Edward (Land Title and Survey Authority of British Columbia).
dct_description_sm: Georeferenced map of Kwikwetlem Nation 1 and 2 Reserves. Land cover and features described on the map includes an "Indian Village", Douglas Island, Pitt River, a wagon road and the types of land and soil. Located on the Kwayhquitlum [Coquitlam] River where it meets the Fraser River.
